ops.title: Release capt-hook 10.0.0 (unified capt-hook.toml + plugin discovery) and roll out fleet-wide
ops.description:
Approved plan: /Users/yasyf/.claude/plans/warm-crafting-dragon.md (branch worktree-packs-unify).

Breaking change: one `capt-hook.toml` with `[pack]` (manifest) + `[packs.*]` (enablement) sections at `.claude/capt-hook.toml`; `pack attach` deleted in favor of `claude plugin list --json` discovery (per-project stat-invalidated snapshot); extras bootstrap retargeted from attach to discovery; scaffold/lint move to the three-artifact contract ([pack] manifest, plugin.json dep floor, marketplace allowlist — zero hooks.json). No migration code in the package.

Rollout sequence (zero dark window — 9.x is blind to the new file; dual-grammar manifests parse under both):
1. Pre-stage ~41 fleet repos: add `.claude/capt-hook.toml` (copy of [packs.*] content), keep legacy packs.toml. Pack-source repos (cc-context, cc-notes, cc-present, getaway) go dual-grammar in one manifest.
2. Additive plugin releases keeping the attach line; cc-notes + show@cc-skills need the plugin.json captain-hook dep AND marketplace allowlist added (both missing); cc-skills marketplace.json needs allowCrossMarketplaceDependenciesOn: ["captain-hook"].
3. Tag v10.0.0 (sync job auto-stamps plugin.json).
4. cc-skills repo-bootstrap templates/manifest.py/tests/settings-onboard.js immediately after.
5. Cleanup plugin releases: drop attach lines + dual-grammar old keys, floors >=10.0.0.
6. Delete legacy packs.toml per repo after confirming 10.x dispatch (capt-hook heartbeats).

ops.text: v10.0.0 tagged; PyPI serves it; plugin.json auto-synced by the release workflow
Fleet repos pre-staged with .claude/capt-hook.toml BEFORE the tag (checklist kept; capt-hook heartbeats verified on at least one repo post-flip)
All five pack plugins (cc-context, cc-notes, cc-present, getaway, show) migrated to the discovery contract with floors >=10.0.0
cc-skills repo-bootstrap templates and docs updated to the new file/contract
